server.name: DataPulse MY
server.description: Read-only access to DataPulse MY's Malaysian public dataset catalogue (122 datasets, 8-status health taxonomy, licence/attribution metadata).

auth.note: All tools are read-only; no auth needed. Rate limiting via Cloudflare Tunnel free tier.

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Find datasets by topic, agency, or licence.

tools.name: get_dataset
tools.description: Full detail + current health for one dataset.

tools.name: find_stale
tools.description: Find datasets whose health is not green (stale, unreachable, unknown-freshness, etc.).

tools.name: get_provenance
tools.description: Citation-ready metadata for one or many datasets (publisher, licence, attribution, source URL).

tools.name: find_by_licence
tools.description: Enumerate what is available under a given licence (e.g. all CC BY 4.0 datasets).

resources.name: Dataset index
resources.description: Lightweight list of all 122 datasets with namespace. Read this first.

resources.name: Licence summary
resources.description: Counts of datasets by licence (e.g. 110 CC BY 4.0 + 12 OGL).

resources.name: Full manifest entry
resources.description: Full schema, source URL, attribution, and current health for one dataset.

rate_limits.note: Cloudflare Tunnel free tier; no per-IP limit published. Be a good citizen.
